major_cooldowns.name: Metamorphosis
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Enter it with maximum Souls and Spirit Bomb more than 10 seconds from ready, and never re-press it with over 5 seconds of buff left.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 187827 is the Vengeance cast and its own self aura; 162264, 200166 and 247121 share the name and are the Havoc leap and its stun.

major_cooldowns.name: Fel Devastation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown with Fury banked, and sync one cast with Fiery Brand when you run Fiery Demise and Down in Flames.

major_cooldowns.name: Sigil of Spite
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it on cooldown whenever it will not overcap Souls, and use it to arm Art of the Glaive as Aldrachi Reaver.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 390163 is the cast id seen in the parses; 389860 shares the name and was not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Soul Carver
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Carve on cooldown at 3 or fewer Souls, and line it up with Fiery Brand when you run Fiery Demise.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Castable per its tooltip but not pressed in the sampled parses, which ran builds without the talent.

major_cooldowns.name: Sigil of Flame
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Precast it on the pull, then drop it on cooldown as your third builder behind Fracture and Immolation Aura.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 204596 is the cast; 204598 is the enemy debuff and 389787 was not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Immolation Aura
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown for the Fury, and push it up the priority in AoE where Fallout shatters extra Souls.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 258920 is the observed Vengeance cast and self aura among many same-name Immolation Aura ids.

rule.description: Fiery Brand into Metamorphosis into Fel Devastation
rule.action: Brand the target, get Metamorphosis rolling, then dump Fury into Fel Devastation.

rule.description: Spend Untethered Rage on a free Metamorphosis
rule.action: Press Metamorphosis off GCD as soon as Untethered Rage procs, since that cast is free.

rule.description: Soul Cleave over Fracture while spending Voidfall
rule.action: Spend with Soul Cleave while your Voidfall stacks are going out instead of pressing Fracture.
Hammer Fracture while Voidfall is building so you reach the third stack sooner.

rule.description: Fracture only with room for its Fury
rule.action: Dump Fury with Soul Cleave before you press Fracture again.
Re-press Demon Spikes the moment the buff drops instead of banking both charges.
